import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF_dist = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INF64_dist = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD_val = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPSILON_val = 1e-10;

    static final int time_steps = 99;
    static final int cost_levels = 15;

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        static final int MAX_VERTICES = 50 * time_steps + 2;
        static final int MAX_EDGES = 2 * MAX_VERTICES * cost_levels + MAX_VERTICES + 7;

        int[] prev_node = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] adjacency_head = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] edge_next = new int[MAX_EDGES * 2];
        int[] edge_dest = new int[MAX_EDGES * 2];
        int num_edges;

        long[] edge_flow = new long[MAX_EDGES * 2];
        long[] edge_capacity = new long[MAX_EDGES * 2];
        long[] edge_cost = new long[MAX_EDGES * 2];

        boolean[] visited_flag = new boolean[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] work_queue = new int[MAX_VERTICES];
        int[] queue_index = new int[MAX_VERTICES];

        long[] shortest_dist = new long[MAX_VERTICES];
        long[] vertex_potential = new long[MAX_VERTICES];

        void clear() {
            num_edges = 0;
            Arrays.fill(adjacency_head, -1);
            Arrays.fill(edge_flow, 0);
        }

        void add_arc(int u, int v, long cap, long price) {
            int idx = num_edges++;
            edge_next[idx] = adjacency_head[edge_dest[idx] = u];
            adjacency_head[edge_dest[idx]] = idx;
            edge_capacity[idx] = cap;
            edge_cost[idx] = price;

            idx = num_edges++;
            edge_next[idx] = adjacency_head[edge_dest[idx] = v];
            adjacency_head[edge_dest[idx]] = idx;
            edge_capacity[idx] = 0;
            edge_cost[idx] = -price;
        }

        void build_potentials(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(vertex_potential, 0);
            for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
                for (int e = 0; e < num_edges; ++e) {
                    if (edge_capacity[e] > 0) {
                        vertex_potential[edge_dest[e ^ 1]] = Math.min(vertex_potential[edge_dest[e ^ 1]], 
                            vertex_potential[edge_dest[e]] + edge_cost[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long improve_flow(int src, int dest, long[] total_expense, int n) {
            Arrays.fill(visited_flag, false);
            Arrays.fill(shortest_dist, INF_dist);
            shortest_dist[src] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(queue_index, -1);

            int head = 0, tail = 0;
            queue_index[work_queue[tail++] = src] = 0;

            while (head < tail) {
                int u = work_queue[head++];
                queue_index[u] = -1;

                for (int e = adjacency_head[u]; e != -1; e = edge_next[e]) {
                    int v = edge_dest[e ^ 1];
                    if (edge_flow[e] < edge_capacity[e] && 
                        shortest_dist[v] > shortest_dist[u] + vertex_potential[u] - vertex_potential[v] + edge_cost[e]) {
                        shortest_dist[v] = shortest_dist[u] + vertex_potential[u] - vertex_potential[v] + edge_cost[e];
                        prev_node[v] = e;

                        if (queue_index[v] == -1) {
                            queue_index[work_queue[tail] = v] = tail;
                            ++tail;
                        }

                        for (int i = queue_index[v], j = (i - 1) / 2; i > 0 && shortest_dist[work_queue[i]] < shortest_dist[work_queue[j]]; i = j, j = (i - 1) / 2) {
                            int tempQueue = work_queue[i];
                            work_queue[i] = work_queue[j];
                            work_queue[j] = tempQueue;
                            
                            int tempIndex = queue_index[work_queue[i]];
                            queue_index[work_queue[i]] = queue_index[work_queue[j]];
                            queue_index[work_queue[j]] = tempIndex;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (shortest_dist[dest] >= INF_dist) return 0;

            long aug = INF64_dist;
            for (int e, node = dest; node != src; node = edge_dest[e]) {
                e = prev_node[node];
                aug = Math.min(aug, edge_capacity[e] - edge_flow[e]);
            }

            for (int e, node = dest; node != src; node = edge_dest[e]) {
                e = prev_node[node];
                edge_flow[e] += aug;
                edge_flow[e ^ 1] -= aug;
                total_expense[0] += aug * edge_cost[e];
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                vertex_potential[i] = Math.min(INF_dist, shortest_dist[i] + vertex_potential[i]);
            }

            return aug;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int SOURCE_VERTEX = 0;
        final int SINK_VERTEX = n * time_steps + 1;
        MinCostMaxFlow flow_instance = new MinCostMaxFlow();
        flow_instance.clear();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            flow_instance.add_arc(SOURCE_VERTEX, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < time_steps; ++t) {
            flow_instance.add_arc(1 + t * n, SINK_VERTEX, INF64_dist, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                    flow_instance.add_arc(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF64_dist, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < cost_levels; ++j) {
                int step_cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < time_steps; ++t) {
                    flow_instance.add_arc(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, step_cost * d + c);
                    flow_instance.add_arc(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, step_cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        flow_instance.build_potentials(MinCostMaxFlow.MAX_VERTICES);

        long[] total_cost = new long[1];
        long total_flow = 0;

        while (true) {
            long delta = flow_instance.improve_flow(SOURCE_VERTEX, SINK_VERTEX, total_cost, MinCostMaxFlow.MAX_VERTICES);
            if (delta == 0) break;
            total_flow += delta;
        }

        if (total_flow != k) {
            throw new AssertionError("Total flow does not match expected value");
        }
        pw.println(total_cost[0]);
        pw.close();
    }
}
